title: One gate, two quanta: the two quanta add exactly until they meet, the gate records the meeting at the update it begins, light leaves by two or three exits fixed by the prepared offset and sign, and a second forward run from the mirror image retraces every click
composition_note: ONE composition (the WAVE 14 builder x_gate_pair_spec: one guide_net@1 placement, the x- and y-lines through the vacuum gap X); every forward run is a control (the member's y-line gauge and packet masks: the board, K alone, Q alone, the hardware alone); the mirror runs are official init files JR(x_T) written from the board's complete final state
